0.name: REST
0.docs: Below this distance from the target, the animation counts as finished.

302.name: to_oklab
302.docs:
Converts a color to OKLab: `[L, a, b, alpha]`. Equal steps in this space look
like equal steps to the eye, which is not true of sRGB.

201.name: velocity
201.docs: Rate of change per second of each component at time `now`.

74.name: into
74.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

198.name: set_target
198.docs:
Sends the value to `target` starting at time `now` (seconds). Asking for
the current target again does nothing, so calling this on every build is fine.

122.name: delta
122.docs: How far the target moved when this segment started.

44.name: without_bounce
44.docs:
The version of this transition for properties that stay animated under
reduced motion (color, opacity): a spring becomes a short fade.

195.name: Animated
195.docs:
A value on its way to a target. It holds no clock: every call takes the time.

Redirecting is continuous. A spring restarts from the current position and
velocity, which is the exact solution for a moved anchor. Tweens are
*additive*: the new one eases in the target's change while earlier ones finish
easing out theirs, and the sum has no corner, even when a hover flickers.

268.name: sample
268.docs: Progress at `t`, where both run from 0 to 1 (a [`CubicBezier`] may overshoot).

40.name: base
40.docs: Small layout and opacity changes (the `duration-base` token).

39.name: fast
39.docs: Hover, press and focus color (the `duration-fast` token, ease-out).

190.name: exact
190.docs: The target exactly as given: at rest, conversions must not change it.

265.name: Emphasized
265.docs: A long, soft landing; for large surfaces entering.

264.name: EaseInOut
264.docs: Slow at both ends; for things moving from one resting place to another.

314.name: sample
314.docs:
Displacement and velocity `t` seconds after starting from displacement
`x0` with velocity `v0`. The spring pulls toward zero.

37.name: Transition
37.docs: How a value travels to a new target.

263.name: EaseOut
263.docs: Starts fast and settles; acknowledges input at once.

313.name: from_response
313.docs:
A spring described the way designers think about it: `response` is the
period of the undamped oscillation in seconds, and `damping_ratio` is
1.0 for no overshoot, less for some bounce.

36.name: Spring
36.docs: A spring, which takes as long as it takes and keeps velocity when redirected.

262.name: EaseIn
262.docs: Starts slowly; for things that leave for good.

35.name: Spring
35.docs:
A damped harmonic oscillator with unit mass, solved in closed form.

Numeric integration drifts with the frame rate and can blow up after a long
frame. The analytic solution gives the same position at a given time however
many frames were drawn on the way there.

261.name: Linear
261.docs: Constant speed; for loops and scrubbing.

311.name: snappy
311.docs: For things that change place or size (the `spring-snappy` token).

310.name: new
310.docs: A spring with this stiffness and damping.

33.name: Tween
33.docs: A fixed duration along a curve.

309.name: damping
309.docs: Braking force per unit of velocity.

32.name: Easing
32.docs: How a timed transition moves from start to end.

308.name: stiffness
308.docs: Restoring force per unit of displacement.

231.name: sample
231.docs:
The curve's height at horizontal position `x`. Newton's method converges
in a few steps almost everywhere; bisection covers the flat spots.

230.name: new
230.docs: A curve with these control points.

3.name: Animatable
3.docs: A value that can be animated: up to four numbers that add and subtract.

229.name: CubicBezier
229.docs:
A timing curve from `(0, 0)` to `(1, 1)` with two control points, the same
as CSS `cubic-bezier()`.

2.name: from_components
2.docs: The value back from interpolated numbers, which may overshoot.

304.name: mix_oklab
304.docs:
Mixes two colors in OKLab with premultiplied alpha, so a fade from
transparent keeps the destination's hue instead of passing through gray.

203.name: is_moving
203.docs: True while the value has not reached its target as of the last [`Self::step`].

354.name: ravenrs_animation

228.name: p2
228.docs: Second control point, x then y.

1.name: to_components
1.docs: The value as numbers to interpolate.

303.name: from_oklab
303.docs: Converts `[L, a, b, alpha]` back to a color, clamped to the sRGB gamut.

202.name: step
202.docs: Forgets what has finished by time `now`. Returns true while still moving.

227.name: p1
227.docs: First control point, x then y.
